newsitem.title: DENMARK: UK's Allied ups stake in Danish drink firm.
newsitem.headline: UK's Allied ups stake in Danish drink firm.

text.p: Danish distiller Danisco said on Wednesday that it had sold part of its 80 percent holding in Selected Wines and Spirits A/S to British beverage group Allied Domecq.
A Danisco statement said its share in Selected Wines and Spirits was reduced to 49 percent, while Allied Domecq's holding rose to 51 percent from its previous 20 percent.

It said that Selected, now renamed Allied Domecq Spirits and Wine Danmark A/S, had a market capitalisation of 5.5 million crowns ($947,000) but did not disclose terms of the sale. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
